info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Windows Background Tasks Accelerometer Models API
Microsoft Windows 10 List loaded ML models

items.docs: Retrieves the list of currently loaded machine learning models. Each model is loaded via the LearningModel class from ONNX format files and provides metadata including the model author, name, domain, description, version, and input/output features.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Load a machine learning model

items.docs: Loads an ONNX machine learning model using LearningModel.LoadFromFilePath or LearningModel.LoadFromStream. The loaded model can then be used to create evaluation sessions. Supports ONNX versions 1.2 and 1.3.

params.name: modelId
params.description: Unique identifier for the loaded model

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a loaded model including its input features (ILearningModelFeatureDescriptor), output features, metadata properties, and device capabilities.

info.name: Microsoft Windows 10 Unload a machine learning model

items.docs: Unloads a machine learning model by calling LearningModel.Close, releasing all associated resources and terminating any active sessions.
